// CHAOS-5156: closes a coverage gap codex round r3 on #2268 surfaced --
// the mixed corpus_jvm_swift directory previously let sibling-language
// fixtures silently satisfy Swift's own "catch"/"?" coverage too, since
// the unfiltered coverage scan didn't separate languages. Swift has real
// do/catch error handling and a real ternary `?:` operator, unlike Go's
// bare-identifier/bare-token quirk fixtures elsewhere in this package.
// Measured directly against real lizard 1.23.0: complexity 3 (base 1 +
// catch + ternary ?).
func f(x: Int) -> Int {
    do {
        return x > 0 ? 1 : 0
    } catch {
        return -1
    }
}
